base: track mixer branch bf42a94 (stacked on PR #110 and the #30 import PR)
scope: Background export with progress, actual-UI cancellation, partial-file cleanup and no-replace publishing
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image (Qt 6.12.0), docker --network none

desktop.note: Two consecutive clean runs. Four further runs each had one private-graph capture failure (pipewire-private-graph, -reference-control or -frame-coded-control), the pre-#111 dropped-cycle flake; this branch predates that retry. desktop-session passed in every run.

verified_behaviors: Export runs on a worker from a copy of the document taken at start; edits, Undo and transport stay available; a second export is refused while one runs

Actual QML: Export shows a progress bar and Cancel export; clicking Cancel during a 192-second export removes NAME.part, leaves no destination and keeps edits, Undo/Redo, path, unsaved state and transport
A 1 MiB RLIMIT_FSIZE makes the write fail mid-stream; the partial file is removed and the message says so
A stale NAME.part from a crash is never reused or overwritten; export refuses with an actionable message
A file created at the destination during export is never replaced (link() refuses); the partial file is removed
An export started before further edits is byte-identical to one rendered from the restored state
Destroying a session during export cancels and joins the worker and leaves no files
limits: Process kill during export can leave NAME.part (documented recovery). Real disk-full and network filesystems were not tested.
